bc_sweep.rationale: inputs over their source populations' output ranges (f_esh up to 60 Hz so the clip at 0 is exercised); constants x0.5-x2.

baseline.reason: intermediate neuronal population of the Gee 2023 reflex network: its firing rate is not measured on its own (parameters were identified from whole-system HR/elastance/ICN data), so there is no component-level data; checked against its exact static map.
